title: Provisional demonstration emergency maternity referral checklist
label: PROVISIONAL — not verified against official GHS guidance
usage_rights: Internal hackathon demonstration only. Do not claim GHS verification.
disclaimer: Rules were authored for prototype demonstration. They were NOT inspected against official Ghana Health Service guidance in this Cursor session.

rules.description: Referral reason must be present and non-empty.
Gestational age must be documented when pregnancy is implied.
Each administered treatment must include administration time.
Do not invent allergies as 'none' when undocumented; state absence.
Document whether receiving facility was contacted (simulation).
Every finding must cite evidence or explicitly state absence.
